title: M3-3 DvP Phase 3: walk-forward engine, B00-B12 on development folds and 2024 validation
objective: Phase 3 of the owner's DvP specification (OWN-074): a preweek walk-forward over completed-game FFA actuals. B00 (offense-only, as declared in METHODOLOGY.md: own prior regressed by a training-only slope, in-season shrinkage with training-only k) and DvP variants B01-B07 (raw, point-in-time residual unshrunk and shrunk, recomputed-baseline residual, prediction-tuned k on a declared grid, recency-weighted, dynamic with last-season prior, non-touchdown components), diagnostics B08, negative controls B09, per-game cutoff B10, projection-contamination resistance B11 and availability-rule sensitivity B12. Rolling-origin development folds 2017-2023, tuning on development only, then 2024 validation with the practical minimum fixed from development data before validation runs. Forecasts frozen before labels join (evaluation_join). Leakage tests T15-T20, T22, T24, T25. 2025 is not touched (Phase 4 needs a frozen manifest). Research only: no weight, service or production change.

review.summary: Read the specification's Phase B (B00-B12), sections 6-7 and 9 (forecast estimator, point-in-time vs recomputed baselines, common eligible rows, paired deltas with block bootstrap, practical minimum from development data only, decision labels, Phase 3 gate), the as-of layer (cutoffs, features_as_of, FrozenForecasts, evaluation_join, league_prior), Phase 2's lab and METHODOLOGY.md where B00 and the metrics were declared, and the reliability results that motivate the variants (D/ST k about 7-9, QB drift, RB rushing yards, touchdowns noise, carryover slopes).

plan.summary: walkforward.py: fold parameters fit on training seasons only (own k by REML, prior slope by carryover, DvP k and slope from training residuals), a preweek or per-game loop over cutoffs using features_as_of, B00 and variants computed per target row from rows available by the cutoff, point-in-time residuals from earlier B00 forecasts, recomputed-baseline residuals, recency weights, last-season priors, non-touchdown components; forecasts frozen and joined to labels only through evaluation_join; metrics per position on common rows (RMSE, MAE, bias, Spearman, calibration deciles, paired delta with block bootstrap, by season and week bins). dvp.py backtest --stage development|validation: development folds 2017-2023 and tuning, then validation 2024 from a candidates file fixed after development; refuses 2025. Tests T15-T20, T22, T24, T25 on synthetic seasons. BACKTEST_REPORT.md and registry records.
